facts.fact: The Câmara Municipal da Praia says the process of identifying and assigning door numbers and street names continues across the capital's neighbourhoods.

The Câmara Municipal da Praia says its Plataforma Municipal de Toponímia, launched in October 2025, is available in its online shop and lets residents locate street names and official building numbers across the Praia municipality.

systems.owner: Câmara Municipal da Praia (Direcção de Topografia, Cadastro e SIG)

note: Only a seven-digit national postcode and a proposal for a single national addressing platform; no address register stated as under way or in service.

facts.fact: Inforpress reports the São Filipe council is running a municipal toponymy project, with a 19 November 2026 session to match inventoried names to streets, squares and plazas, under a protocol with Correios de Cabo Verde for street plates and house numbering.

systems.owner: Câmara Municipal de São Filipe with Correios de Cabo Verde

facts.fact: Expresso das Ilhas reports Praia's municipality is placing 100 street-name plaques in seven neighbourhoods, has approved Vila Esperança's street names, and has its Municipal Toponymy Platform open for consulting street names and door numbers.

Mindelo (São Vicente) municipality, which began its street-naming project in 2014, signed a partnership with Correios de Cabo Verde to update it, and says it is updating records and toponymic studies in expansion zones.

Voz do Archipelago reports Praia's municipality launched its Municipal Toponymy Platform (Cityhub) on 2 October 2025, with an address search by street name, to assign street names and door numbers, not yet covering all neighbourhoods.
